notes: Justia returned 'Page not found' for the requested 2025 vintage; fell back to 2024 (actual_vintage_used=2024) per the handoff substitution rule. AR's 2024 lobbying-disclosure regime is essentially the same as 2015: Title 21 Ch. 8 Subchapters 4 (general/definitions/penalty/gift rules §§ 21-8-401 to 407), 5 (single-section AG investigation § 21-8-501 — subchapter page is its leaf), and 6 (lobbyist registration / activity reports / recordkeeping / prohibited acts §§ 21-8-601 to 607). REGIME DROP from 2015: Title 10 (General Assembly) Ch. 1 was a populated 'General Provisions' chapter in 2015 hosting legislative-branch lobbying support provisions; in the 2024 Justia snapshot Title 10 Ch. 1 is listed as 'GENERAL PROVISIONS [RESERVED]' (not exposed as a chapter URL in the TSV) and the remaining Title 10 chapters (2-6 plus Sunset Laws appendix) do not contain lobbying content. Pass-1 still selected Title 10 per the handoff's split-regime guidance, but pass-2 returned an empty urls list with rationale in notes. Tree depth 6 reflects state -> code -> title -> chapter -> subchapter -> section. Pass-3 fetch on subchapter-5/ returned an empty TSV, so the subchapter URL itself goes into proposed_urls as the leaf (same convention as AR 2015 prior). Final URL count: 15 (all Title 21).
